name: Borja Giménez Larraz - § 57/1
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘recalls that action on homelessness is primarily a competence of the Member States, while the EU should support and coordinate efforts;’ and ‘calls on the Member States to adopt national targets to prevent the eviction of children in cases where there is a clear risk of homelessness’
